title: Shared genetic and molecular architecture between insulin resistance and cognitive performance.
abstract: GWAS summary statistics for 11 insulin-resistance-related traits (N=53,334-933,970) and 10 cognitive measures (N=28,156-436,853) were analyzed for global and local genetic correlations, with multivariate fine-mapping and eQTL annotation. Low-to-moderate genetic correlations were observed between six IR-related traits and seven cognitive measures (|r|=0.08-0.34), predominantly in opposite directions. Local genetic correlations showed mixed effect directions, and multivariate fine-mapping prioritised 696 shared likely causal variants.
